model_card.summary: Final VQA/joint teacher baselines and CE/CE+KL smaller multimodal students.
model_card.scope: Compare frozen synthetic VQA/joint teachers with fresh smaller language models and width8 vision/audio encoders trained by CE or CE+KL, reducing visual tokens from 16 to 4 and measuring original held-out tasks and modality masking.
limitations: synthetic shapes and tones; no natural VQA capability claim
smaller prefix does not imply successful distillation
CE and KL students have the same initialization, training plan and heldout denominators
Teacher agreement, held-out gold accuracy and storage/timing are distinct outcomes. This small run cannot establish universal compression gains.

Reported file-byte counts measure the experiment's source inference artifacts. The public exporter removes RNG/training metadata, so published file sizes can differ; tensor-byte counts describe the stored model tensors.
The 16→4 visual-token comparison retains generated tasks, not natural-image/general audio ability. Raw teacher-answer logits are omitted.

Both tasks use distinct frozen teachers; all four students start with fresh random width32, one-layer language models and width8 vision/audio encoders, without copying SFT or encoder weights. Teacher language width is 64; teacher/student totals are 145664/36096 parameters.

Each CE/CE+KL pair has identical initialization and batch plan and completes 350 updates. VQA uses 36 training rows/8391 answer tokens; joint uses 24/16104. Teacher and student expanded prediction positions differ by the 12-token visual-prefix reduction; the code checks identical gold-answer IDs for every sampled record before KL.
KL worsens held-out exact match in this run: VQA teacher/CE/KL = 9/12, 9/12, 8/12; joint = 12/12, 8/12, 6/12. Better VQA validation (10/12 KL versus 9/12 CE) does not establish better test quality.

Joint KL emits circle for all 12 test shapes and has identical raw output IDs on all 12 paired blank-image inputs; its pitch labels remain 12/12 correct. This demonstrates no image-grounding gain on those test rows. Joint CE has 8/12 shape matches and ten unchanged paired blank-image outputs.

The fixed VQA teacher is the all branch, not the earlier partial branch that scored 12/12. joint-ce_kl.pt is the predeclared primary student, not the best test-performing student. All checkpoints are complete native multimodal inference weights.

Reducing visual tokens does not shrink every component: patch8 width8 VisionEncoder has 1664 parameters versus patch4 width16 teacher encoder 1344. The complete student is smaller because its language model and other components shrink; this is not a fourfold encoder-parameter reduction.
